intro: Korran is a Darkspear troll researcher stationed at the Crossroads in the Barrens. Serving Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar, he monitors odd happenings across the scrublands and studies the emerging menace of the insectoid silithid.

p: While most at the Crossroads concern themselves with aggressive quilboar and local centaur clans, Korran keeps a watchful eye on subtler, more insidious threats. Stationed on orders from Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar, the troll scout observes the changing land and coordinates the collection of intelligence for the Horde's leadership.

Korran's primary concern has shifted south toward the Field of Giants, where strange insectoid creatures known as silithid have begun burrowing into the earth. Disturbed by their aggressive nature and rapid encroachment, he enlists passing adventurers to dig up intact eggs using his claw tool, attempting to decipher where the swarm originated and what danger it poses to the young Horde.
